backward_compatibility: Readers must accept all earlier anthology-entry versions; new fields/views are additive unless a future major version explicitly provides a lossless adapter. Previously delivered self-contained HTML remains valid.
generalized_learning_candidates: Backward ascent and descent are not symmetric reversed motions.
A preparatory pelvis shift can be the load-bearing movement atom even when the visible footstep appears to be the action.
Contact/load should follow environmental test rather than precede it.
Animation/prose compression should preserve anticipation, contact, and recovery when deleting intermediate motion.
